name: dsh-appearance
description: 为 DSH 配置外观功能。支持主题配色、本地字体、配置导入复制与皮肤切换。

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-claude-code run build && node scripts/skin-center-bundles && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-center run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-claude-code run test && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skin-center run test && node --test scripts/dsh-skin.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
